    Who We Are
    Built on Trust.
    Driven by Consistency.

    A Canadian company that believes a clean space is an essential service — something everyone deserves.

    Why Choose OTIS?

    Founded in 2020 during the pandemic, OTIS was built on the belief that a clean home, property, business, or workspace is an essential service — something everyone deserves. We approach our clients' needs with consistency and genuine care.

    Whether you need cleaning weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly, you can rely on Otis for high-quality service. We build strong customer relationships founded on communication, reliability, and trust — with competitive pricing that ensures our team is properly compensated, because a happy team delivers excellent results.

    🤝

    We show up when we say we will — every single time.
